args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money was using ROUND_HALF_UP while its docstring and FIN-212
require banker's rounding. Import and use ROUND_HALF_EVEN so that
half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66),
matching tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This violates the half-even rule for exactly-half cases, e.g. `Decimal("2.665")` was rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`.

## Fix
- Changed `round_money` in `src/money.py` to import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, matching the function's docstring and FIN-212.
- No other changes needed; `tests/test_money.py` already encodes the expected behavior.

## Verification
- CI (run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986`) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")` ✓
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` ✓ (banker's rounding)
